protocol: fresh Codex context with only Convertigo Flow MCP and Playwright

timing.interpretation: The complete fresh run took 8m51s. The application was built after 5m58s; the remaining 2m53s was dominated by two Playwright MCP extension-mode stalls.

toolingFindings.finding: The fast FrontAst mutator resolved ForEach children as Children while canonical Flow Svelte uses Each, so picker mutations below an If branch failed.
toolingFindings.impact: The agent made 14 tree inspections and 8 failed mutations before applying six bindings through one source patch.
toolingFindings.resolution: Engine now resolves Each contextually and falls back to the Svelte parser; the frontbuilder preserves Each versus Children while rendering. Fixed in e07b18a and 6ec16d0 and proven through the live MCP.

toolingFindings.finding: Playwright MCP extension mode had no active browser relay and left navigation pending.
toolingFindings.impact: The fresh agent spent 2m53s after a successful build and could not complete browser proof.
toolingFindings.resolution: Headless MCP without --extension completed the same navigation in seconds. The autonomous/CI rule is documented in 653a673.

toolingFindings.finding: flow-app-progress identifies each missing descendant binding but does not return a composed bulk repair.
toolingFindings.impact: Even with valid mutation paths, six leaf bindings still encourage repeated inspect/mutate calls.
toolingFindings.next: Return executable fixes for inferred iterator fields and allow one ordered mutation batch for all unambiguous bindings.

projectedAfterObservedFixes.note: Removes the 8 failed mutations, repeated leaf inspections and extension-mode browser retries; this projection requires a fresh Run10 for confirmation.
